names.trigger: No specific trigger context is established. The dominant components act broadly across nearly all corpus items, with one component strongest near sentence endings in assistant responses.
names.behaviour: The weight projections suggest a broad bias toward advertising-related tokens such as "Ads", "advertisements", and "advertising", with some additional AI-related tokens. names.reasons: The edit spans 205 matrices, and the eight reported components account for only 3.0% of total effect; seven have approximately 99–100% activation breadth. Neither the diverse activation snippets nor the joint view identifies a selective trigger.
